purpose: Exploratory reanalysis of measured macrophage expression; no collagen prediction or treatment calibration
unit: author-normalized RMA log2 intensity per probe set; not gene counts
biological_system: Male mouse liver macrophages after CCl4 injury; 24h Ly6Chi versus 72h Ly6Clo; time and phenotype confounded
data_role: exploratory development; already inspected source metadata and source cited by reference-model authors; not independent validation
preprocessing: None beyond parse/finite/unique checks; no renormalization, no feature selection, no gene mapping
primary_statistic: Unscaled multivariate pseudo-F: between-group sum of squared distances to grand centroid divided by within-group sum of squares / 4, across all probe sets; df_between=1
permutation: All 20 labelled 3-versus-3 allocations; upper-tail count including observed allocation, complement ties included; tolerance 1e-10 relative
interpretation: Conditional exchangeability only. n=3 biological array replicates/group, unknown pooling; same study, no randomization assumption established. Minimum attainable exact two-group p is 0.1; no claim p<0.05
descriptives: sample means, sample SD, pairwise RMS distances in log2 units
mean(72h)-mean(24h) effect distribution and count abs(delta)>=1, not significance or gene counts
leave-one-out-one-per-group (9 subsets of 2+2) sign concordance and retention abs(delta)>=1 among originally abs(delta)>=1; descriptive, not independent replications
software_acceptance: Exact input hashes, six expected sample columns and SDRF associations, all finite and unique241576 IDs
Toy separated/null fixtures; all20 allocations; complement symmetry; sample swap invariance; reject nonfinite/duplicates/hash mismatch
Rerun deterministic statistics exactly equal; do not alter criteria after seeing results
scientific_acceptance: No therapeutic success threshold. Report observed effect, uncertainty and limitations regardless of direction; no independent biology claim.

account_budget.scope: Shared account weekly window; rounded/delayed display; checked between packages
